fields.title: Estimate migration
fields.inputs/1/label: B. Multiple delivery addresses per order
fields.inputs/2/label: C. Mandatory date of birth for new users
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Order by cost and specify the order of magnitude (hours / days / weeks).
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: B. Allow multiple delivery addresses per order
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/2: C. Make "date of birth" mandatory for new users
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: A (hours) → C (days) → D (days) → B (weeks). A doesn't touch old records. C requires a product decision on old users, but no backfill. D lives in two versions until clients update. B changes cardinality and touches everything. The order of C and D is debatable; what matters is that both are an order of magnitude cheaper than B.
